title: Schedule of Covered Perils and Claim Limits, Northgate Protect
content:
The perils a Northgate Protect plan covers, the food-loss maximum and the number of approved claims allowed in any rolling 12 months are fixed per tier as follows.

## Perils by tier

| Peril | Standard 2-Year | Standard 3-Year | Accident 2-Year | Accident 3-Year | Accident 4-Year | Complete Monthly |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Mechanical and electrical failure from normal use | Covered | Covered | Covered | Covered | Covered | Covered |
| Failure from normal wear and tear | Covered | Covered | Covered | Covered | Covered | Covered |
| Power surge damage | Covered | Covered | Covered | Covered | Covered | Covered |
| Accidental damage from handling (drops, spills, cracked screens) | Not covered | Not covered | Covered | Covered | Covered | Covered |
| Rechargeable battery holding less than 80 percent of original capacity | Not covered | Not covered | Covered | Covered | Covered | Covered |
| Theft or loss | Not covered | Not covered | Not covered | Not covered | Not covered | Not covered |
| Cosmetic damage that does not affect function | Not covered | Not covered | Not covered | Not covered | Not covered | Not covered |

## Manufacturer warranty, food loss and claim count

| Tier | Mechanical failure inside the manufacturer warranty referred to the manufacturer | Most paid for food lost when a covered refrigerator or freezer fails, per claim | Most approved claims in any rolling 12 months |
|---|---|---|---|
| Standard 2-Year | Yes | $250.00 | No limit |
| Standard 3-Year | Yes | $250.00 | No limit |
| Accident 2-Year | Yes | $0.00 | 2 |
| Accident 3-Year | Yes | $0.00 | 2 |
| Accident 4-Year | Yes | $0.00 | 3 |
| Complete Monthly | Yes | $0.00 | 4 |

## Points of judgement

- On every tier, a mechanical failure inside the manufacturer warranty period is referred to the manufacturer instead of being covered.
- A food-loss maximum of $0.00 means the tier pays nothing for food lost; only the Standard tiers carry a food-loss amount, $250.00 per claim.
- *Hypothetical:* a tablet dropped and cracked is accidental damage; it is covered on an Accident tier or Complete Monthly and not on a Standard tier.
